subject: Tranche acceleration: utilization normalization & hot-standby plan
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@orchid.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@orchid.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Usage spike + renewal window – need help sizing additional capacity

Hi Mateo,

Quick note from our side: over the past 6 weeks we saw sustained 3.4x growth in inference tokens for our recommender model tied to a marketing campaign. Our dashboard (attached) shows average GPU utilization for the dedicated pool hitting 92% and tail latencies spiking into SLA risk windows.

We have a renewal coming up Dec 15 and want to discuss either accelerating an additional tranche or adding a hot-standby buffer so we don’t degrade user experience during the next campaign. Key asks:
- Can Redwood size a short-term supplement (20–30 H100-equivalent slots) while we commit to a larger tranche at renewal?
- What tradeoffs exist if we instead allocate mixed SKUs (some A100 + H100) for cost efficiency?
- Can you provide a fast mutual action plan with timelines and a ballpark delta on monthly cost?

Attached: orchid-usage-nov.csv (monthly usage by hour).

Thanks,
Lina
Director of Engineering
Orchid AI
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@orchid.ai>
Cc: Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@orchid.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike + renewal window – need help sizing additional capacity

Hi Lina — thanks for the data; this is the kind of signal we want to catch early. Quick read: your sustained tail utilization and the 95th percentile token wall are the primary drivers for the hotspot.

Proposed short-term approach (fast lane):
1) Tranche acceleration: immediate +20 H100-equivalent slots applied as a 60-day top-up to bridge to renewal.
2) Hot-standby pool: add a mixed hot-standby of 10 slots (A100) + 6 slots (H100) to handle burst and model-mix spikes. We pick A100 for lower-cost background inference and H100 for critical low-latency paths.
3) Model-mix rebalancing: enable prefix KV caching for the recommender and reduce sequence lengths for background sampling where possible — estimated 12–18% token reduction.
4) Fallback policy: if the hot-standby is exhausted, route non-critical requests to a lower-cost variant to preserve SLAs on critical routes.

Ballpark monthly delta (rough): +$48k/month for the 60-day tranche (+costs scale if you choose all H100). Full SOW attached (proposed-sow-hot-standby-v1.pdf).

Next steps: can you confirm budget authority and whether Orchid prefers a pure H100 supplement or the mixed SKU hot-standby? If you say go, we can tee up an ops playbook and 48–72h onramp.

Cheers,
Mateo
Account Executive, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Lina Park <lina.park@orchid.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike + renewal window – need help sizing additional capacity

Lina / team — operational notes from infra:
- We can deliver a 60-day tranche within 48h for up to +24 H100-equivalent slots assuming no conflicting maintenance windows.
- Mixed-SKU approach is recommended for cost parity: place A100s in the background/long-tail lanes and reserve H100s for low-latency prefixes.
- Observability checks: we will push per-route latency/queueing dashboards and apply KV-cache profiles immediately; that typically cuts redundant tokenization and reduces steady-state costs ~10–15%.
- Safety-net sizing: we suggest a hot-standby buffer of ~12 slots (equivalent to ~8 H100 + 4 A100) to cover 95th percentile surges without invoking fallbacks.

I attached ops-capacity-notes.md with a short checklist: maintenance blackout windows, kernel affinity constraints, and anticipated kernel warm-up times (H100 warm-up can add a 1–3s cold-window per instance for large seqs).

If Orchid wants an accelerated onramp, we’ll need a PO or an explicit email approval to start provisioning and spin up monitoring hooks.

—Kimberly
Head of Dedicated Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@orchid.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@orchid.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike + renewal window – need help sizing additional capacity

Thanks — we reviewed the proposal with finance. We can approve a 45-day accelerated tranche for +18 H100-equivalent slots, and we’re open to the mixed-SKU hot-standby idea, but we’d like a revised price that favors A100-heavy buffering (we're OK with H100 only on critical routes).

Action items from our side:
- I’ll send a formal PO once you send an amended SOW that shows: (a) 45-day tranche, (b) hot-standby 10 A100 + 4 H100, (c) pricing revision with blended SKU rates.
- We need the onramp to complete before Dec 6th (marketing campaign starts Dec 8).

Can you deliver the revised SOW by end of day Dec 1?

Ravi
Head of Prod Ops
Orchid AI
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@orchid.ai>, Lina Park <lina.park@orchid.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2026 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike + renewal window – need help sizing additional capacity

Ravi — thanks, and understood on the Dec 6 onramp requirement. We will: 
- Draft an amended SOW with the 45-day tranche and the hot-standby mix you requested.
- Update pricing to show blended A100/H100 rates and include the ops/monitoring line items (no surprise fees).
- Target: amended SOW and mutual-action checklist by EOD Dec 1 (link: https://redwood.app/drive/ORCH-2026/mutual-action-plan).

Kimberly / Soojin — can you prioritize the SOW revision and include an explicit provisioning timeline (48–60h from PO receipt) and playbook for routing fallbacks? I’ll attach finance for amendment once we have the doc.

Mateo
Account Executive, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
